//: Does not extend packages/config/tsconfig.base.json — that base targets browser/React apps (jsx, DOM lib) per ADR-0005/0006's own frontends; this is a pure Node.js service with no UI, so it defines its own Node-appropriate compiler options instead of fighting a React-shaped base. Shares the same strictness bar (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, etc.) as every other TypeScript workspace member, per PRINCIPLES:CONSISTENCY_OVER_NOVELTY applied to what actually matters (strictness), not to settings that don't apply here (jsx, DOM lib). This is the typecheck-everything config (src + test); tsconfig.build.json is the narrower, src-only config the production build actually emits from.
